tier1.headline: Your data is shared broadly
tier1.quote: We may share information, including Personal Data, to our affiliates and with trusted third parties that provide services for Equativ, such as hosting and internet connectivity, Demand-Side Partners (DSP), third-party data providers or advertisers, and anti-fraud tools providers.

tier1.headline: Your data improves our services
tier1.quote: When Equativ acts as controller we may process Personal Data including for: the analysis of privacy signals, ensuring security, preventing fraud and debugging, the improvement of Equativ’s services , the management of the commercial relationship with our clients, client support, billing.

tier1.headline: Your sensitive financial data collected
tier1.quote: Under U.S privacy laws, we may have access to sensitive personal information such as precise geolocation in accordance with such laws.

tier2.headline: Your data shared across affiliates
tier2.quote: Personal Data may be transferred to our affiliates or a partner located outside the EU/EEA including to third-countries for which the European Commission has not adopted an adequacy decision yet.

tier2.headline: Your data is retained for 13 months
tier2.quote: Unless otherwise required by applicable laws, Personal Data will be retained for a maximum of 13 months.

tier2.headline: Your precise location is used
tier2.quote: When we are joint controllers with our Supply Partners, we process Personal Data for the following purposes: Store and/or access information on a device; Use limited data to select advertising ; Create profiles for personalized advertising; Use profiles to select personalized advertising; Measure advertising performance; Where and if applicable we may rely on use the following features within these purposes: match and combine data from other data sources, link different devices, use of precise geolocation.
